parts.title: Scalar Arithmetic
parts.description: Implement add, multiply, power, and subtract on Value nodes, each wiring up its local backward closure.

parts.title: Activations
parts.description: Implement ReLU, tanh, and exp on Value nodes with their local gradients.

parts.title: Reverse-Mode Autodiff
parts.description: Topologically sort the graph and run reverse-mode backprop from a scalar output.

parts.title: Neural Network
parts.description: Build neurons, layers, and an MLP out of Value nodes.

parts.title: Training
parts.description: Collect parameters, an MSE loss, zero_grad, an SGD step, and the training loop.

steps.name: v_add
steps.doc: Return a Value holding the sum of a and b, propagating gradient to both addends.

steps.name: v_mul
steps.doc: Return a Value holding the product of a and b, with the product-rule gradient.

steps.name: v_pow
steps.doc: Return a Value holding a raised to the constant power n, with the power-rule gradient.

steps.name: v_sub
steps.doc: Return a Value holding the difference a minus b, propagating gradient with opposite signs.

steps.name: v_relu
steps.doc: Apply the rectified linear unit (clamp negatives to zero) to a Value.

steps.name: v_tanh
steps.doc: Apply the hyperbolic tangent activation to a Value.

steps.name: v_exp
steps.doc: Apply the natural exponential to a Value.

steps.name: build_topo
steps.doc: Return the nodes of root's graph in depth-first postorder (children before parents, root last).

steps.name: backward
steps.doc: Seed root's grad to 1.0 and run each node's _backward in reverse topological order.

steps.name: init_neuron
steps.doc: Create a neuron as a dict of nin random weights in [-1,1] and a zero bias.

steps.name: neuron_forward
steps.doc: Compute tanh of the weighted sum of inputs x plus the neuron's bias.

steps.name: layer_forward
steps.doc: Apply every neuron in the layer to the same input list x, returning their outputs.

steps.name: mlp_forward
steps.doc: Thread the input list x through each layer in turn and return the last layer's outputs.

steps.name: parameters
steps.doc: Return a flat list of all weight and bias Values across every neuron in every layer.

steps.name: mse_loss
steps.doc: Return the summed squared-error Value between predictions and target floats.

steps.name: zero_grad
steps.doc: Reset the .grad of every parameter Value to 0.0.

steps.name: sgd_step
steps.doc: Update each parameter's data in place by a gradient-descent step of size lr.

steps.name: train
steps.doc: Run n_steps of full-batch SGD on the MLP and return the list of per-step loss floats.
